title: Six first-run setup page titles are Title Case among sentence-case titles (en; three in sv)
claim: Of the 41 config/options page titles in translations/en.json, 6 -- all on the first-run path (user 'Heat Pump Optimizer Setup', temperature 'Temperature Settings', thermal, zones, dhw, weather_sensitivity) -- are Title Case while the rest read in sentence case ('Your building', 'Heat Pump Optimizer options'); sv carries 3 of the same pattern ('Termisk modell & Optimering', 'Värmepumpsoptimering - Konfiguration', 'Tvåzons- & Solkonfiguration').
mechanism: The older initial-flow step titles were written in Title Case and translated literally; the later pages (building, options) follow sentence case, the Home Assistant UI convention, so a new user meets both styles in consecutive pages.

evidence.machine: box B10 (4 vCPU, Linux, CPython 3.14 venv-ci, Node 22)
evidence.contention_note: a count over file-delivered strings, contention-immune
evidence.unit: count of en config/options step titles with a capitalised non-first word that is neither an acronym nor a proper name (of 41)

instrumented_symbol: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/translations/en.json and sv.json: config.step.*.title / options.step.*.title (the strings Home Assistant renders as the form heading)

perturbation.change: --perturb=sentence_titles: every en/sv page title sentence-cased in memory, acronyms and the product's proper names kept

metric_definition: en step titles in which some word after the first starts with an uppercase letter followed by lowercase and is not in the proper-name list
phenomenon_property: Every config and options page title in en and sv uses one casing convention (sentence case, the one the other 35 titles use).

null_control.note: sentence-case titles with proper names ('Heat Pump Optimizer options') are not counted, so the proper-name exclusion does not hide or invent hits

proposed_fix_scope: Sentence-case the six en titles (and the three sv ones) in strings.json/translations; de is unaffected (nouns capitalised).
